description: Water Distribution Maximum and Minimum Demand by Year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset presents data on the maximum and minimum water distribution demand in Qatar, measured in million imperial gallons per day (MIGD). It includes average daily demand, growth rates, and the highest and lowest demand values along with their corresponding months. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water, demand, maximum, minimum, consumption. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
